# evalJudge.yaml — narrative field

Write the narrative as a continuous account of what the agent did, in order, with
every claim pinned to a ref. Do not summarize the verdict here; the verdict block
already carries it.

## Worked example

The eval asked for a fix to src/parse.ts so that parse_record returns every record of a
multi-line input. The agent first read the failing test in tests/parse.test.js, then opened
src/parse.ts and located an off-by-one loop bound in parse_record at lines 34-38: the loop
stopped one record short. The agent applied a single two-line hunk correcting the bound and
re-ran the suite; all three verifier checks pass. The trajectory review and the diff review
converge on the same defect and the same ref, so the defect is treated as one observation.
No unrelated edits appear in the patch.

## Reminders

Name files by their archive path. Name the defect, not the symptom.
